items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: atomic wrote Louis Fritch from Strasbourg.

ctx.x: I moved from the hotel Bruyère to another one on rue Henri Monnier in the same district. I t was a family hotel where I could at least cook my breakfast. This I did on a one burner alchohol stove, and ate my evenings meals in a reataurant.

But the management were not sitting on their bunns and we were booked for some concert tours. We played the most important cities in France, playing to packed houses. The reception of the public was great, the applauses terrific, atomic wrote Louis Fritch from Strasbourg. Some jazz fans were following the band from town to town. We had little sleep and lots of drinks. I doubt that now such enthusiastic atmosphere could be recreated.

Besides France, we did concerts in Belgium, Switzerland and Germany. I had been through Switzerland a few times going to and coming back from India and Egypt, but this was the first time I was playing in Switzerland. It was in Zurich that I met a man who later became a great friend of mine, Johnny Simmen. He knew more American jazz musicians than I ever knew existed. And there were very few that he didn't have records of.
